summary: Verified core production readiness concepts covering dynamic port binding (process.env.PORT + 0.0.0.0), liveness vs. readiness probe boundaries, graceful shutdown connection draining, reverse proxy keepAliveTimeout race prevention, expand-and-contract zero-downtime database migrations, and build-time vs. runtime configuration isolation.
evidence: Confirmed process.env.PORT dynamic binding and 0.0.0.0 interface listening prevents orchestrator connection refusal on eth0.
Validated GET /health inspects internal event loop viability only, preventing cluster-wide CrashLoopBackOff restart storms during downstream database blips.
Validated GET /ready probes active PostgreSQL connectivity and drain status, enabling load balancer routing pool withdrawal without container restarts.
Verified SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown halts new queue polling, finishes in-flight requests, and gracefully disconnects Prisma and Redis pools.
Verified keepAliveTimeout=65000 and headersTimeout=66000 prevents 502 Bad Gateway TCP race conditions behind 60s idle-timeout reverse proxies.
Verified pre-deploy expand-and-contract migration strategy ensures v1 pods remain 100% compatible and rollbacks do not require destructive schema drops.
Confirmed strict separation between immutable Docker ARG build-time compilation and runtime environment secret injection.
